title: HushSpec Canonical Form Test Vector v1
description: A test vector for spec/hushspec-canonical.md. Each vector pairs a resolved HushSpec document with the exact canonical JSON serialization and content hash a conformant implementation MUST produce for it. Vectors live under fixtures/core/hash/ and are generated by scripts/canonical_json.py.

description.description: What this vector exercises, citing the spec section.

source.description: Informational: the unresolved document the `policy` below was produced from (for vectors that exercise a resolved extends chain). Never canonicalized directly.

policy.description: The resolved HushSpec document to canonicalize. MUST NOT contain `extends` or `merge_strategy`.

canonical.description: The exact RFC 8785 canonical JSON text (UTF-8) of the canonical projection of `policy`.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of `canonical`, in the `sha256:<lowercase hex>` wire form.
